notes: This contract pins the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador update-rate query declarations to Umbra's bounded embedded implementation. It verifies exact Lab signatures, exception sets, adapter symbols, and a real Catch2 selector. The query path now consumes retained ordinary/regional subscription designators and returns their FDD rates; subscription throttling, rate reduction, the rate-bearing Turn Updates On overload, MOM, transport, package evidence, protected review, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside the slice.
